purpose: Teach: ハブ/シューズ/マックス/サバ/鷹/樹脂/メダル/必修

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、新しい鉛筆、ハブのキャラが、ついてるの、可愛いよ、見て!
lines.en: Mom — I got a new pencil with this cute character on it. Look!
lines.style: Bright, urgent excitement. Quick intake of breath before speaking. Bouncing rhythm, words tumbling out. Holding the pencil up for inspection, voice lifting on the final word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。新しいシューズ、運動会用、買ってあげるわね、翔くん、楽しみね。
lines.en: That's wonderful. I'm going to buy you some new shoes for the sports day. You must be so excited about it.
lines.style: Warm and attentive, mirroring his excitement without overwhelming it. Gentle, maternal tone. Speaks at an even pace, each phrase thoughtful. Soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、声、マックスで、応援してくれたよ、ぼくの試合、嬉しかったよ。
lines.en: Dad cheered so loud during my race. He was really cheering for me — I was so happy!
lines.style: Animated and glowing. Voice bouncing with the memory. Emphasis on how loud Dad was, voice rising to show the volume. A small laugh underneath, genuine pride bubbling through.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日の夜ご飯、サバの塩焼きよ、お父さん、好きなのよね、楽しみだわね。
lines.en: For dinner tonight we're having grilled mackerel with salt — your father's favorite. There's so much to look forward to.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing warmth. Speaking as though already seeing the evening unfold. Calm, almost meditative pace. Voice lands softly on 'favorite' — she knows this brings him pleasure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 絵本の鷹さん、ぼく、強くて、かっこいいなって、思ったんだ、ママ、見て。
lines.en: I saw a hawk in the picture book, and I thought it was so strong and cool. Mom, did you see?
lines.style: Thoughtful and slightly wondering. Voice quieter than before, turning inward. Genuine curiosity about her opinion. Speaks slowly, as if turning the image over in his mind. Soft, almost reverent.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんがくれた、樹脂の置物、リビングに、飾ってあるのよ、知ってた、翔くん?
lines.en: Do you remember the resin figure your father gave me? The one we have displayed in the living room?
lines.style: Reflective, drawing him into a gentle memory. Speaking as though remembering aloud. Warm and patient, inviting him to remember too. No rush — a moment of connection being offered.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 運動会で、銅メダル、ぼく、もらったんだよ、ママ、誇らしいんだ!
lines.en: I won a bronze medal at the sports day, Mom! I'm so proud of myself!
lines.style: Bursting with pride and accomplishment. Voice steady but bright. Speaks with unguarded joy — this matters to him. Quick pace, emphasis on 'I' and 'bronze medal.' Voice climbing slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さんの大学時代、英語、必修科目で、苦労したのよ、翔くんも、頑張ってね。
lines.en: When I was in university, English was a required subject and I really struggled with it. You'll do great — keep trying your best.
lines.style: Tender and honest, touching his shoulder with words. Admits her own difficulty without heaviness. Slows at the encouragement, voice becoming steady and sure. Closing words are a quiet, genuine blessing.
